proposed.page_title: Channel Catfish | Department of Natural Resources

quotes.quote: Bait options range from nightcrawlers, leeches, chicken blood, chicken liver, chicken or fish guts, crawdads, grasshoppers, water dogs, live and dead minnows, cut bait and a variety of prepared stink baits.
Always use the lightest weight needed and a slip sinker.
Ten-pound test line is suggested over lighter weight line since the bait is fished on the bottom and often near underwater snags.
